acceptance: Crate `aipo-poppy` implemented with `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`, exposing the Poppy host profile over `aipo-host` without contaminating Core IR, bytecode or VM with engine specifics
Poppy host surface is described as data via AHS (`HostSchema`) under the `poppy` capability tree (`poppy.ecs`, `poppy.random`)
Entity identities use generational `Handle`s from `aipo-host` with stale handle detection preventing use-after-free
Structural ECS mutations (spawn, despawn, add component, remove component) are recorded into a command buffer and deferred to explicit safe points
Behavior lifecycle adheres to plain interface semantics (`init`, `update`) without custom language keywords
Headless Poppy simulation is completely deterministic: fixed tick, seeded PRNG, command buffer ordering, yielding identical state digests across repeated runs with the same seed
Executable headless demo fixture verifies deterministic multi-tick simulation and command buffer execution
